style: Bluegrass old-time string-band drive and theatrical gospel harmony. Harmonic system: pedal-tone harmony with rotating upper structures and non-diatonic cluster rubs. Melodic system: ornamental folk turns, rapid patter, and yodel register flips. Rhythmic system: waltz pulse invaded by swinging triplet subdivisions and abrupt metric compression. Timbre and atmosphere: banjo, fiddle, mandolin, upright bass, stomps, body percussion, and dry close-mic capture with 1960s room bleed. Performance attitude: theatrical overstatement delivered with deadpan administrative precision. Anchor: a ringing high banjo drone that remains constant while the accompaniment undergoes topological folding and temporal distortion. Operators: hold the banjo drone fixed while the string band migrates; compress the waltz meter while stretching the vocal lines; make the administrative text behave like a structural prayer; preserve the rhythmic foot-stomps while destabilizing the chord progressions.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Banjo drone rings steady]
[Dry foot-stomps on downbeat]
Attention auditors of the geometric fold.
The tesseract has consumed three gallons of grain alcohol.
It is sitting in the corner of the municipal warehouse.
Its dimensions are slurring into one another.
[Fiddle enters with chromatic slide]
The top face is hiccuping.
The bottom face is trying to sing a barber-shop chord.
Fill out Form Ninety-Four for spatial intoxication.
[Spoken deadpan]
Do not attempt to fold the polyhedron while it is in this condition.

[Chorus]
[Massed gospel vocal harmony, tight cluster rubs]
Oh, the corners are staggering!
The vertices are slurring!
When the geometric solid hits the moonshine bucket,
Every right angle turns into a drunken ducket!
[Mandolin rapid tremolo]
File the paperwork in triplicate!

[Verse 2]
[Metric compression: waltz pulse shifts to erratic triplet subdivisions]
Article two of the bureaucratic code:
Intoxicated hypercubes must be leashed to a fence post.
It tried to slide through a three-dimensional keyhole.
It got stuck halfway because of excessive perimeter bloat.
[Fiddle and banjo cross-rhythms clash]
Witnesses report the fourth dimension smells like mash.
It hiccuped a hyper-plane and dropped with a heavy crash.
[Clerk voice]
Note in the margin: the perimeter is slurring.
The interior angles are no longer perpendicular.

[Chorus]
[Massed vocal harmony with yodel register flips]
Oh, the corners are staggering!
The vertices are slurring!
When the geometric solid hits the moonshine bucket,
Every right angle turns into a drunken ducket!
[Stomps accelerate abruptly]

[Bridge]
[Music drops to unaccompanied upright bass and dry speech-song]
We measured the hangover of the secondary axis.
It requires twelve aspirin and a modified calculus.
The seventh dimension is currently vomiting prime numbers.
While the eighth dimension sleeps and heavily slumbers.
[Instruments re-enter with sudden harmonic shift]
Apply cold wet towels to the main diagonal.
This is a routine administrative coronal.

[Verse 3]
[Rapid patter singing over driving string-band rhythm]
The tax collector tried to audit its internal volume.
He got lost inside a non-Euclidean column.
We sent a search party with a compass and a flask.
They returned two days later wearing a different mask.
[Fiddle sawing furiously]
The tesseract is sleeping it off behind the town hall.
Its coordinates are leaning against the brick wall.

[Chorus]
[Ecstatic gospel shouting with barbershop voice leading]
Oh, the corners are staggering!
The vertices are slurring!
When the geometric solid hits the moonshine bucket,
Every right angle turns into a drunken ducket!

[Outro]
[Banjo drone continues alone as rhythm slows down]
Case closed.
The geometry is sobering up.
Remove the empty bucket.
File the sobriety certificate.
[Single final foot-stamp]
[Silence]
caption: A drunken tesseract staggers through a municipal bluegrass string band. Built by Substrate Smuggler, Sensory Freak, Omission Cartographer, and Cosmic Clerk. It combines old-time acoustic instrumentation, tight gospel harmony, rapid patter, and deadpan bureaucratic narration to process an impossible geometry on a moonshine bender.
